decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves a specialist defence niche with long procurement cycles, so its value is still unresolved and the line costs little to keep listed.
The spring-balanced desk lamp complements the ergonomic workplace range at low holding cost, and two years of results are not enough to justify giving up the option.
As a second-generation core interior luminaire with low uncertainty, the C80-P G2 deserves continued commitment rather than abandonment.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship of the firm's direction toward efficient, glare-controlled lighting, so it is a strategic option to build on.

Since the firm already withdrew the related marine searchlight and HMI technology is being displaced by LED, the case for this line is weakening, but its low holding cost still justifies keeping it open a while longer.
